reconstructed_theorem_text: For every finite type J with decidable equality, every j in J, and every x in EuclideanSpace R J, let p_j(x)=e_j-x_j*x. Then the real inner product satisfies <x,p_j(x)>=(1-||x||^2)*x_j. No unit-norm or nonzero assumption on x is made.

domains: EuclideanSpace R J; real inner product and real coordinates.
